### Convergence of the Spatial Smooth
The code below fits the model ensemble for different basis set sizes of the spatial smooth to examine the convergence of the validation error.

```{r Convergence basis set, eval=TRUE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Basis-set convergence for the spatial smooth
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

k_values <- c(100, 200, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000)
k_values <- k_values[k_values <= k_spatial]

model_grid_basis <- expand.grid(fold = 1:N, k_spatial = k_values)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: replace k for the two-dimensional spatial smooth in a formula
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

set_spatial_k <- function(formula, k) {

  replace_spatial_smooth <- function(expr) {

    if (!is.call(expr)) {return(expr)}

    # Identify:
    # s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, ...)
    if (identical(expr[[1]], as.name("s")) &&
        length(expr) >= 3 &&
        identical(expr[[2]], as.name("coordinate_east")) &&
        identical(expr[[3]], as.name("coordinate_north"))) {

      args <- as.list(expr)

      # Replace existing k if present
      arg_names <- names(args)

      if (!is.null(arg_names) && "k" %in% arg_names) {

        args[["k"]] <- k

      } else {

        args[["k"]] <- k
      }

      return(as.call(args))
    }

    # Recursively search the rest of the formula
    for (j in seq_along(expr)) {

      if (j > 1) {expr[[j]] <- replace_spatial_smooth(expr[[j]])}
      
    }

    expr
  }


  formula_new <- formula

  formula_new[[3]] <- replace_spatial_smooth(formula[[3]])

  environment(formula_new) <- environment(formula)

  formula_new
  
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit or load basis-convergence models
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (load) {

  models_basis <- readRDS("saved_files/models_basis.rds")

} else {

  models_basis <- future_lapply(seq_len(nrow(model_grid_basis)),

    function(idx) {

      row <- model_grid_basis[idx, ]


      # Use the final GAM2 specification, changing only the spatial basis size
      formula_basis <- set_spatial_k(formula = gam2_formula, k = row$k_spatial)

      fit_fold(i = row$fold,
               data = dataset_property_sales_cv,
               formula = formula_basis,
               fraction = 1.0,
               checkpoint_prefix = paste0("basis_k", row$k_spatial))
    }
  )


  names(models_basis) <- paste0("Model",
                                model_grid_basis$fold,
                                "_k",
                                model_grid_basis$k_spatial)


  saveRDS(models_basis, "saved_files/models_basis.rds")
  
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract predictions and residuals
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

get_residuals_grid <- function(models,
                               dataset,
                               grid_df,
                               grid_name) {

  residual_list <- future_lapply(seq_along(models),

    function(i) {

      model_name <- names(models)[i]
      model <- models[[i]]

      row <- grid_df[i, ]
      fold <- row$fold


      predicted_sales_price <- as.numeric(predict.gam(model, newdata = dataset, type = "response"))


      tibble(sales_price = dataset$sales_price,
             predicted_sales_price = predicted_sales_price,
             residual_sales_price = predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price,
             residual_sales_price_percent = 100 * (predicted_sales_price - dataset$sales_price) / dataset$sales_price,
             residual_sales_price_log = log(predicted_sales_price) - log(dataset$sales_price),
             validation = dataset$validation_set == fold,
             municipality_type = dataset$municipality_type,
             Model = model_name,
             value = row[[grid_name]])
    }
  )


  bind_rows(residual_list)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Residuals
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

residual_df_basis <- get_residuals_grid(models = models_basis,
                                        dataset = dataset_property_sales_cv,
                                        grid_df = model_grid_basis,
                                        grid_name = "k_spatial")


saveRDS(residual_df_basis, "saved_files/residual_df_basis.rds")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Performance
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

performance_basis <- residual_df_basis %>%
                     mutate(type = if_else(validation, "Validation error", "Training error")) %>%
                     group_by(type, municipality_type, value) %>%
                     summarise(MALE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_log)), .groups = "drop") %>%
                     rename(k = value)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

plot_basis <- ggplot(performance_basis,
                     aes(x = k, y = MALE, color = municipality_type, lty = type)) +
                     geom_line() +
                     geom_point() +
                     labs(x = "Number of spatial basis functions (k)",
                          y = "MALE",
                          color = "Municipality type")


saveRDS(plot_basis, "saved_files/plot_basis.rds")

print(plot_basis)

```

# 4. Paper II: "Property and Land Value Predictions with Generalized Additive Models" 

### 4.1 Standard-house construction
In the code below, lot sales and properties are augmented with a fictitious single-family house corresponding to a set of standard building characteristics. Their standardized property value is subsequently calculated. 

```{r Standardization, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results= 'hide'}

standardize_property <- function(data, reference_data) {
  
    data %>% mutate(year_built = 1970,
                    year_rebuilt = 1970,
                    living_space = 140,
                    lot_size = 800,
                    maximum_coverage_percentage = 30,
                    number_of_divisions = 1,
                    number_of_bathrooms = 1,
                    house_type = factor("Detached", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$house_type))),
                    roof_type = factor("Fiber cement", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$roof_type))),
                    wall_type = factor("Brick", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$wall_type))),
                    heating_type = factor("District heating", levels = levels(factor(reference_data$heating_type))))
  }


if (load) {

  dataset_property_sales_cv <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_property_sales_cv.rds")
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized.rds")
  dataset_properties <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_properties.rds")
  dataset_properties_standardized <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_properties_standardized.rds")

} else {
  
  #standardize 
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized <- standardize_property(dataset_lot_sales_cv, reference_data = dataset)
  dataset_properties_standardized <- standardize_property(dataset_properties, reference_data = dataset)
  
  #calculate standarized prices for each model 
  for (model_name in names(models)) {
    
    dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties_standardized[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties[[paste0("standard_property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties_standardized, type = "response"))
    dataset_properties[[paste0("property_value_", model_name)]] <- as.vector(predict.gam(models[[model_name]], dataset_properties, type = "response"))
  
  }
  
  #restore original lot variables but leave standard building characteristics on the lot
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$lot_size <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$lot_size
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$maximum_coverage_percentage <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$maximum_coverage_percentage
  dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized$number_of_divisions <- dataset_lot_sales_cv$number_of_divisions

  #save
  saveRDS(dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized, "saved_files/dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_property_sales_cv, "saved_files/dataset_property_sales_cv.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_properties, "saved_files/dataset_properties.rds")
  saveRDS(dataset_properties_standardized, "saved_files/dataset_properties_standardized.rds")

}

```


### 4.2 Model specifications and fitting
The code below fits three alternative GAM approaches for estimating lot values. The direct lot model is trained exclusively on lot sales using location, time, lot characteristics, and surrounding amenities. The standard-property model relates lot-sale prices to the predicted value of a standardized property, while additionally controlling for selected lot and spatial characteristics. The combined model is fitted jointly to property sales and lot sales and distinguishes the two sale types through a type effect and a type-specific spatial adjustment. For each approach, one model is fitted per cross-validation fold using the remaining $K-1$ folds as the training data. To isolate model sensitivity to changes in the training population, each model was fitted using the complete training sample (chunk.size = nrow(training_subset)). Using a single chunk reduces this source of numerical variation, making differences across cross-validation folds more directly interpretable as sensitivity to training-data perturbations (see https://stats.stackexchange.com/questions/659490/reproducibility-of-bam-mgcv-algorithm).

```{r Lot-value models, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results= 'hide'}

if (load) {
  
  models_direct <- readRDS("saved_files/models_direct.rds")
  models_standard_property <- readRDS("saved_files/models_standard_property.rds")
  models_combined <- readRDS("saved_files/models_combined.rds")
  
} else {
  
  # -------------------------
  # 1. Direct lot model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_direct_fold <- function(i,
                              data,
                              k_spatial,
                              k_other = k_other,
                              checkpoint_prefix = "direct_lot",
                              save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    training_subset <- data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    model <- bam(sales_price ~ s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(sales_date_numeric, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 2024) +
                               s(lot_size, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 800) +
                               s(coast_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1500) +
                               s(lake_distance, k = k_other, pc = 500) +
                               s(stream_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(road_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(highway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(train_station_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(railway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(windturbine_distance, k = k_other, pc = 3000) +
                               s(ocean_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(lake_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(forest_size, k = k_other, pc = 0),
                data = training_subset,
                chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                family = tw(link = log),
                method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kother%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_other)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
      
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 2. Standard-property model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_standard_property_fold <- function(i, 
                                         data, 
                                         k_spatial, 
                                         k_standard_property = 10, 
                                         checkpoint_prefix = "standard_property", 
                                         save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    training_subset <- data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    standard_property_var <- paste0("standard_property_value_Model", i)
    
    formula_standard_property <- as.formula(paste0("sales_price ~ ",
                                                   "s(", standard_property_var, ", k = ", k_standard_property, ") + ",
                                                   "s(lot_size, k = 6, pc = 800) + ",
                                                   "s(maximum_coverage_percentage, k = 3, pc = 30) + ",
                                                   "s(number_of_divisions, k = 3, pc = 1) + ",
                                                   "s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, ",
                                                   "k = ", k_spatial,
                                                   ", pc = c(697000, 6150000))"))
    
    model <- bam(formula_standard_property,
                 data = training_subset,
                 chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                 family = tw(link = log),
                 method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kstandard%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_standard_property)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 3. Combined model
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_combined_fold <- function(i,
                                lot_data,
                                property_data,
                                k_spatial,
                                k_other = k_other,
                                checkpoint_prefix = "combined",
                                save_checkpoint = TRUE) {
    
    lot_training_subset <- lot_data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    property_training_subset <- property_data %>% filter(validation_set != i)
    
    training_subset <- bind_rows(lot_training_subset, property_training_subset)
    
    model <- bam(sales_price ~ s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, k = k_spatial, by = type_ordered, pc = c(697000, 6150000)) +
                               s(sales_date_numeric, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 2024) +
                               s(year_built, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
                               s(year_rebuilt, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 1970) +
                               s(living_space, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 140) +
                               s(lot_size, k = k_other, by = municipality_type, pc = 800) +
                               s(coast_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1500) +
                               s(lake_distance, k = k_other, pc = 500) +
                               s(stream_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(road_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(highway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(train_station_distance, k = k_other, pc = 2000) +
                               s(railway_distance, k = k_other, pc = 1000) +
                               s(windturbine_distance, k = k_other, pc = 3000) +
                               s(ocean_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(lake_view, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(forest_size, k = k_other, pc = 0) +
                               s(number_of_bathrooms, k = 2, by = municipality_type, pc = 1) +
                               house_type * municipality_type +
                               roof_type * municipality_type +
                               wall_type * municipality_type +
                               heating_type * municipality_type +
                               type,
                 data = training_subset,
                 chunk.size = nrow(training_subset),
                 family = tw(link = log),
                 method = "fREML")
    
    if (save_checkpoint) {
      
      filename <- sprintf("%s_fold%d_kspatial%d_kother%d.rds",
                          checkpoint_prefix,
                          i,
                          k_spatial,
                          k_other)
      
      saveRDS(model, file = file.path("checkpoints", filename))
    }
    
    model
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 4. Shared ensemble helper
  # -------------------------
  
  fit_model_ensemble <- function(fit_fun,
                                 N,
                                 checkpoint_prefix,
                                 ...) {
    
    models <- future_lapply(seq_len(N), function(i) {
      
      message("Fitting ", checkpoint_prefix, ", fold ", i, " of ", N, " ...")
      
      fit_fun(i = i, checkpoint_prefix = checkpoint_prefix, ...)
      
    })
    
    names(models) <- paste0("Model", seq_len(N))
    
    models
  }
  
  # -------------------------
  # 5. Fit model ensembles
  # -------------------------
  
  models_direct <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_direct_fold,
                                      N = N,
                                      checkpoint_prefix = "direct_lot",
                                      data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                      k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                      k_other = k_other)
  
  models_standard_property <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_standard_property_fold,
                                                 N = N,
                                                 checkpoint_prefix = "standard_property",
                                                 data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                                 k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                                 k_standard_property = 10)
  
  models_combined <- fit_model_ensemble(fit_fun = fit_combined_fold,
                                        N = N,
                                        checkpoint_prefix = "combined",
                                        lot_data = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                        property_data = dataset_property_sales_cv,
                                        k_spatial = k_spatial,
                                        k_other = k_other)
  
  # -------------------------
  # 6. Save complete ensembles
  # -------------------------
  
  saveRDS(models_direct, "saved_files/models_direct.rds")
  
  saveRDS(models_standard_property, "saved_files/models_standard_property.rds")
  
  saveRDS(models_combined, "saved_files/models_combined.rds")
  
}

```

## 4.3 Partial effects

#### Spatial smooths 
The code below extracts and visualizes the spatial smooths from each of the three lot-value model ensembles. For every fold-specific model, the estimated spatial effect and its standard error are evaluated on a common coordinate grid covering Denmark. For the combined model, both the shared spatial surface and the sale-type-specific spatial adjustment are extracted.

```{r Spatial smooths lot models, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=30}

# -------------------------------
# Helper 1: complete prediction grid
# -------------------------------
complete_grid_for_model <- function(model, grid) {
  
  model_data <- model.frame(model)

  for (var in setdiff(all.vars(formula(model)), names(grid))) {
    
    x <- model_data[[var]]

    if (is.factor(x)) {
      grid[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(grid)), levels = levels(x))
    } else if (is.ordered(x)) {
      grid[[var]] <- ordered(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(grid)), levels = levels(x))
    } else {
      grid[[var]] <- 0
    }
  }

  grid
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 2: extract spatial terms
# -------------------------------
extract_spatial_terms <- function(model, grid, type_level = NULL) {

  grid <- complete_grid_for_model(model, grid)

  if (!is.null(type_level) && "type_ordered" %in% names(grid)) {
    grid$type_ordered <- ordered(
      rep(type_level, nrow(grid)),
      levels = levels(model.frame(model)$type_ordered)
    )
  }

  predictions <- predict.gam(model, grid, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)

  fit <- as.data.frame(predictions$fit)
  se  <- as.data.frame(predictions$se.fit)

  term_names <- names(fit)

  global_term <- term_names[term_names == "s(coordinate_east,coordinate_north)"]

  by_terms <- grep("^s\\(coordinate_east,coordinate_north\\):type_ordered", term_names, value = TRUE)

  out <- list()

  if (length(global_term) == 1) {
    out$global <- list(effect = fit[[global_term]],
                       se = se[[global_term]],
                       term = global_term)
  }

  if (!is.null(type_level) && length(by_terms) > 0) {
    matched <- by_terms[grepl(paste0(type_level, "$"), by_terms)]

    if (length(matched) == 1) {
      out$type_specific <- list(effect = fit[[matched]],
                                se = se[[matched]],
                                term   = matched)
    } else {
      out$type_specific <- list(effect = rep(0, nrow(grid)),
                                se = rep(0, nrow(grid)),
                                term   = paste0("reference type: ", type_level))
    }
  }

  out$grid <- grid
  out
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 3: predict spatial grids
# -------------------------------
make_spatial_prediction_results <- function(
    models,
    coordinate_grid,
    include_type_specific = FALSE
) {

  future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {

    model <- models[[i]]
    model_name <- names(models)[i]

    if (include_type_specific) {
      type_levels <- levels(model.frame(model)$type_ordered)
    } else {
      type_levels <- NULL
    }

    global_res <- extract_spatial_terms(model, coordinate_grid)

    results <- list()

    if (!is.null(global_res$global)) {
      
      grid <- global_res$grid
      grid$effect_coordinates <- global_res$global$effect
      grid$se_coordinates     <- global_res$global$se
      grid$effect_coordinates[grid$ocean] <- NA
      grid$se_coordinates[grid$ocean]     <- NA

      results[[paste0(model_name, "_global")]] <- list(model_name = model_name,
                                                       smooth_name = "Global spatial smooth",
                                                       grid = grid)
    }

    if (include_type_specific) {
      for (tl in type_levels) {
        type_res <- extract_spatial_terms(model,
                                          coordinate_grid,
                                          type_level = tl)

        grid <- type_res$grid
        grid$effect_coordinates <- type_res$type_specific$effect
        grid$se_coordinates     <- type_res$type_specific$se
        grid$effect_coordinates[grid$ocean] <- NA
        grid$se_coordinates[grid$ocean]     <- NA

        results[[paste0(model_name, "type", tl)]] <- list(model_name = model_name,
                                                          smooth_name = paste("Type-specific spatial smooth:", tl),
                                                          type_level = tl,
                                                          grid = grid)
      }
    }

    results
  }) |>
    unlist(recursive = FALSE)
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 4: plotting
# -------------------------------
plot_model_terms_from_grid <- function(
    grid,
    model_name,
    smooth_name,
    effect_range,
    se_range
) {

  plot_effect <- ggplot(grid) +
                 geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north,
                           fill = effect_coordinates)) +
                 scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                  name = paste("Partial effect\n", model_name),
                                  na.value = "white",
                                  limits = effect_range) +
                 geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                              color = "black",
                              size = 0.4) +
                 coord_fixed() +
                 labs(title = smooth_name, x = "", y = "") +
                 theme_void() +
                 theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                       legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                       legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                       legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                       legend.title.align = 0.5)

  plot_se <- ggplot(grid) +
             geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north,
                       fill = se_coordinates)) +
             scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                              name = bquote(sigma[.(model_name)]),
                              na.value = "white",
                              limits = se_range) +
             geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                          color = "black",
                          size = 0.4) +
             coord_fixed() +
             labs(title = paste("SE:", smooth_name), x = "", y = "") +
             theme_void() +
             theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                   legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                   legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                   legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                   legend.title.align = 0.5)

  list(effect = plot_effect, se = plot_se)
}


# -------------------------------
# Helper 5: full workflow
# -------------------------------
build_spatial_smooth_plots <- function(models,
                                       coordinate_grid,
                                       include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                       save_path = NULL) {

  prediction_results <- make_spatial_prediction_results(
                        models = models,
                        coordinate_grid = coordinate_grid,
                        include_type_specific = include_type_specific)

  all_effects <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))

  max_abs_effect <- max(abs(all_effects), na.rm = TRUE)
  effect_limits <- c(-max_abs_effect, max_abs_effect)

  all_ses <- unlist(lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$se_coordinates))

  effects_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(prediction_results, \(x) x$grid$effect_coordinates))

  base_grid <- prediction_results[[1]]$grid
  base_grid$se_across_models <- apply(effects_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  base_grid$se_across_models[base_grid$ocean] <- NA

  se_limits <- c(0, max(c(all_ses, base_grid$se_across_models), na.rm = TRUE))

  plot_lists <- lapply(prediction_results, function(res) {
    
    plot_model_terms_from_grid(grid = res$grid,
                               model_name = sub("^Model", "Model ", res$model_name),
                               smooth_name = res$smooth_name,
                               effect_range = effect_limits,
                               se_range = se_limits)
  })

  plots <- unlist(plot_lists, recursive = FALSE)

  plot_sd_across <- ggplot(base_grid) +
                    geom_tile(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, fill = se_across_models)) +
                    scale_fill_scico(palette = "vik",
                                     name = expression(sigma[Ensemble]),
                                     na.value = "white",
                                     limits = se_limits) +
                    geom_contour(aes(coordinate_east, coordinate_north, z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                                 color = "black",
                                 size = 0.4) +
                    coord_fixed() +
                    labs(title = "SD across spatial smooths", x = "", y = "") +
                    theme_void() +
                    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
                          legend.position = c(0.85, 0.75),
                          legend.title = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(b = 5)),
                          legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
                          legend.title.align = 0.5)

  plots <- c(plots, list(sd_across_models = plot_sd_across))

  if (!is.null(save_path)) {
    saveRDS(plots, save_path)
  }

  plots
}

plots_spatial_direct <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_direct, 
                                                   coordinate_grid,
                                                   include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                                   save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_direct.rds")

plots_spatial_standard_property <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_standard_property, 
                                                              coordinate_grid,
                                                              include_type_specific = FALSE,
                                                              save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_standard_property.rds")

plots_spatial_combined <- build_spatial_smooth_plots(models_combined, 
                                                     coordinate_grid,
                                                     include_type_specific = TRUE,
                                                     save_path = "saved_files/plots_spatial_combined.rds")


#plots
wrap_plots(plots_spatial_direct, ncol = 3)
wrap_plots(plots_spatial_standard_property, ncol = 3)
```

```{r Other smooth effects lot models, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide'}
# -------------------------
# 2. Helper: standard-property smooth
# -------------------------

make_standard_property_smooth_plot <- function(models, model_set_name) {
  
  smooth_dfs <- imap(models, function(mod, model_name) {
    
    fold_number <- str_extract(model_name, "\\d+")
    var_name <- paste0("standard_property_value_Model", fold_number)
    
    df <- tryCatch(smooth_estimates(mod, smooth = paste0("s(", var_name, ")"), partial_match = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) {return(NULL)}
    )
    
    if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
    
    df %>% rename(standard_property_value = all_of(var_name)) %>%
           mutate(Model = sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name))
  })
  
  smooth_dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smooth_dfs)
  
  if (length(smooth_dfs) == 0) { return(NULL) }
   
  combined_df <- bind_rows(smooth_dfs)
  
  ggplot(combined_df,
  aes(x = standard_property_value,
      y = .estimate,
      linetype = Model)) +
  geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
              aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
                  ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se),
              alpha = 0.15,
              color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
  labs(title = paste0(model_set_name, ": Standard property value"),
       x = "Standard property value",
       y = "Partial effect",
       linetype = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
  
}

# -------------------------
# 3. Helper: generic smooth plot
# -------------------------

make_single_smooth_plot <- function(models, model_set_name, var, label) {
  
  smooth_dfs <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    
    mod <- models[[model_name]]
    
    df <- tryCatch(smooth_estimates(mod, smooth = paste0("s(", var, ")"), partial_match = TRUE),
                   error = function(e) {return(NULL)}
    )
    
    if (!is.null(df)) {df$Model <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)}
    
    df
    
  })
  
  smooth_dfs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), smooth_dfs)
  
  if (length(smooth_dfs) == 0) {return(NULL)}
  
  combined_df <- bind_rows(smooth_dfs)
  
  has_by <- ".by" %in% names(combined_df) && any(!is.na(combined_df$.by))
  
  plot_title <- paste0(model_set_name, ": ", label)
  
  if (has_by) {
    
    by_var_name <- unique(na.omit(combined_df$.by))[[1]]
    
    p <- ggplot(combined_df,
                aes(x = .data[[var]],
                    y = .estimate,
                    color = .data[[by_var_name]],
                    linetype = Model,
                    group = interaction(Model, .data[[by_var_name]]))) +
        geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
        aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
            ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se,
            fill = .data[[by_var_name]]),
        alpha = 0.15,
        color = NA) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        labs(title = plot_title,
             x = label,
             y = "Partial effect",
             color = NULL,
             fill = NULL,
             linetype = NULL) +
        theme_minimal()
    
  } else {
    
    p <- ggplot(combined_df,
                aes(x = .data[[var]],
                    y = .estimate,
                    linetype = Model)) +
         geom_ribbon(data = subset(combined_df, Model == "Model 1"),
                     aes(ymin = .estimate - 1.96 * .se,
                     ymax = .estimate + 1.96 * .se),
                     alpha = 0.15,
                     color = NA) +
         geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "black") +
         labs(title = plot_title,
              x = label,
              y = "Partial effect",
              linetype = NULL) +
         theme_minimal()
  }
  
  p
}

# -------------------------
# 4. Main plot function
# -------------------------

make_smooth_plots <- function(models, model_set_name, smooth_variables) {
  
  plot_smooths <- list()
  
  for (var in names(smooth_variables)) {
    
    if (var == "standard_property_value") {
      
      p <- make_standard_property_smooth_plot(models = models, model_set_name = model_set_name)
      
    } else {
      
      p <- make_single_smooth_plot(models = models,
                                   model_set_name = model_set_name,
                                   var = var,
                                   label = smooth_variables[[var]])
    }
    
    if (!is.null(p)) {plot_smooths[[var]] <- p}
  }
  
  plot_smooths
}
```

#### Factor effects
The code below extracts and plots the factor effects for the combined model. A point is shown for the effect of each model but error bars are shown only for Model 1. 

```{r Factor effects lot models, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE, results = 'hide', fig.width=20, fig.height=20}

factor_variables <- c(house_type = "House type",
                      municipality_type = "Municipality type",
                      type = "Type",
                      roof_type = "Roof type",
                      wall_type = "Wall type",
                      heating_type = "Heating type")

make_termwise_df <- function(model, model_data, variable, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {

  v_vals <- unique(model_data[[variable]])
  
  if (is.null(interaction_by)) {
    df <- data.frame(setNames(list(v_vals), variable), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    m_vals <- unique(model_data[[interaction_by]])
    grid_list <- setNames(list(v_vals, m_vals), c(variable, interaction_by))
    df <- expand.grid(grid_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    df[[interaction_by]] <- factor(df[[interaction_by]], 
                                   levels = levels(model_data[[interaction_by]]))
  }
  for (var in setdiff(all.vars(formula(model)), names(df))) {
    x <- model_data[[var]]
    if (is.factor(x)) {
      df[[var]] <- factor(rep(levels(x)[1], nrow(df)), levels = levels(x))
    } else {
      df[[var]] <- 0
    }
  }
  return(df)
}

combine_all_term_effects <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  pattern <- paste0("^", term, "$|^", term, ":" ,"|:", term, "$")
  cols_to_sum <- grep(pattern, names(df), value = TRUE)
  df[[paste0("effect_", term)]] <- rowSums(as.matrix(df[cols_to_sum]))
  return(df)
}

combine_all_term_se <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  pattern <- paste0("^", term, "$|^", term, ":" ,"|:", term, "$")
  cols_to_sum <- grep(pattern, names(df), value = TRUE)
  df[[paste0("se_", term)]] <- sqrt(rowSums(as.matrix(df[cols_to_sum])^2))
  return(df)
}

plot_term_effect <- function(df, term, interaction_by = "municipality_type") {
  
  effect_col <- paste0("effect_", term)
  lower_col <- paste0("lower_", effect_col)
  upper_col <- paste0("upper_", effect_col)
  df_sub <- df %>% filter(term == !!term)
  plot_title <- paste("Partial effect of", gsub("_", " ", term))

  p <- ggplot(df_sub, aes(x = .data[[term]], 
                          y = .data[[effect_col]], 
                          shape = Model,
                          group = interaction(Model, if (identical(term, interaction_by) || 
                                                        !(interaction_by %in% names(df_sub))) NULL 
                                                     else .data[[interaction_by]]))) +
      geom_pointrange(data = subset(df_sub, Model == "Model 1"),
                      aes(ymin = .data[[lower_col]], ymax = .data[[upper_col]]),
                      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                      size = 0.8) +
      geom_point(data = subset(df_sub, Model != "Model 1"),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
                 size = 2.5) +
      coord_flip() +
      labs(x = NULL, y = "Partial effect", title = plot_title, shape = "Model") +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  if (interaction_by %in% names(df_sub)) {
      color_var <- if (term == interaction_by) term else interaction_by
      p <- p + aes(color = .data[[color_var]]) +
      scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2", name = "Municipality type")
  }

  return(p)
}

factor_dfs <- list()

for (model_name in names(models_combined)) {

  model <- models_combined[[model_name]]
  model_data <- model.frame(model)
  relevant_factors <- factor_variables[names(factor_variables) %in% all.vars(formula(model))]

  for (var in names(relevant_factors)) {

    interaction <- if (var == "municipality_type") NULL else "municipality_type"
    df <- make_termwise_df(model, model_data, var, interaction_by = interaction)
    df$term <- var

    terms <- predict.gam(model, df, type = "terms", se.fit = TRUE)
    df_predictions <- as.data.frame(terms$fit)
    df_se <- as.data.frame(terms$se.fit)

    combined_predictions <- combine_all_term_effects(df_predictions, var, interaction_by = interaction) %>% 
                            select(starts_with("effect_"))
    
    combined_se <- combine_all_term_se(df_se, var, interaction_by = interaction) %>% 
                   select(starts_with("se_"))

    df_final <- df %>% select(all_of(c(var, interaction)), term) %>%
                       bind_cols(combined_predictions) %>%
                       bind_cols(combined_se) %>%
                       mutate(across(starts_with("effect_"),
                                     ~ . - 1.96 * get(str_replace(cur_column(), 
                                     "effect_", 
                                     "se_")),
                                     .names = "lower_{.col}")) %>%
                       mutate(across(starts_with("effect_"),
                                     ~ . + 1.96 * get(str_replace(cur_column(), "effect_", "se_")),
                                     .names = "upper_{.col}"))

    df_final$Model <- sub("^Model", "Model ", model_name)
    factor_dfs[[length(factor_dfs) + 1]] <- df_final
  }
}

df_all_factors <- bind_rows(factor_dfs)
plot_factors <- lapply(names(factor_variables), function(term) {plot_term_effect(df_all_factors, term)})
names(plot_factors) <- names(factor_variables)

wrap_plots(plot_factors, ncol = 2) +
           plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
           theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                 legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
                 legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
                 legend.box = "horizontal",
                 legend.justification = "center")

```

## 4.4 Predictive performance
The code below extracts various residual types for each type of lot model and calculates different performance measures for the training and validation set. Note that using N-fold cross-validation means that there are N-1 estimates for each training point, and the training error is simply taken as the average over these. 

```{r Performance lot sales, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# -------------------------
# 1. Residuals for lot-sales evaluation
# -------------------------

get_lot_residuals <- function(models, dataset_lot_sales_cv, model_approach,
                              fold_from_name = TRUE) {
  
  residual_list <- future_lapply(seq_along(models), function(i) {
    
    model_name <- names(models)[i]
    model <- models[[i]]
    
    fold <- if (fold_from_name) {
      as.integer(sub("^Model(\\d+).*$", "\\1", model_name))
    } else {
      i
    }
    
    predicted_sales_price <- as.vector(predict.gam(model, newdata = dataset_lot_sales_cv, type = "response"))
    
    tibble(model_approach = model_approach,
           Model = model_name,
           sales_price = dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price,
           sales_date_numeric = dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_date_numeric,
           predicted_sales_price = predicted_sales_price,
           residual_sales_price = predicted_sales_price - dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price,
           residual_sales_price_percent = (predicted_sales_price - dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price) / dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price * 100,
           residual_sales_price_log = log(predicted_sales_price) - log(dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price),
           ratio = predicted_sales_price / dataset_lot_sales_cv$sales_price,
           validation = dataset_lot_sales_cv$validation_set == fold,
           id = dataset_lot_sales_cv$id,
           municipality_type = dataset_lot_sales_cv$municipality_type)
  })
  
  bind_rows(residual_list)
}

# -------------------------
# 2. Residuals for each approach
# -------------------------

residual_direct_lot <- get_lot_residuals(models = models_direct,
                                         dataset_lot_sales_cv = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                         model_approach = "Direct lot model")

residual_standard_property <- get_lot_residuals(models = models_standard_property,
                                                dataset_lot_sales_cv = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                                model_approach = "Standard property model")

residual_combined <- get_lot_residuals(models = models_combined,
                                       dataset_lot_sales_cv = dataset_lot_sales_cv_standardized,
                                       model_approach = "Combined model")

residual_df_lot_models <- bind_rows(residual_direct_lot,
                                    residual_standard_property,
                                    residual_combined)

saveRDS(residual_df_lot_models, "saved_files/residual_df_lot_models.rds")


# -------------------------
# 3. Performance helper
# -------------------------

summarise_lot_performance <- function(residual_df, group_vars) {
  
  residual_df %>% mutate(dataset_type = if_else(validation, "Validation", "Training")) %>%
                  group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
                  summarise(MALE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_log), na.rm = TRUE),
                            MAPE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent), na.rm = TRUE),
                            MAE = mean(abs(residual_sales_price), na.rm = TRUE),
                            PM20 = mean(abs(residual_sales_price_percent) <= 20, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
                            COD = mean(abs(ratio - median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE)), na.rm = TRUE) / median(ratio, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
                            PRD = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE) /(sum(predicted_sales_price, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(sales_price, na.rm = TRUE)),
                            .groups = "drop")
}

# -------------------------
# 4. Countrywide and municipality-type performance
# -------------------------

performance_countrywide_lot_models <- summarise_lot_performance(residual_df_lot_models, group_vars = c("model_approach", "dataset_type")) %>%
                                      mutate(municipality_type = "Countrywide")

performance_municipality_type_lot_models <- summarise_lot_performance(residual_df_lot_models, group_vars = c("model_approach", "dataset_type", "municipality_type")) %>%
                                            mutate(PRD = NA_real_)

performance_lot_models <- bind_rows(performance_countrywide_lot_models, performance_municipality_type_lot_models)

municipality_levels <- c("Countrywide", sort(setdiff(unique(performance_lot_models$municipality_type), "Countrywide")))

performance_sorted_lot_models <- performance_lot_models %>%
                                 mutate(model_approach = factor(model_approach, levels = c("Direct lot model", "Standard property model", "Combined model")),
                                        dataset_type = factor(dataset_type, levels = c("Training", "Validation")),
                                        municipality_type = factor(municipality_type, levels = municipality_levels),
                                        MAE = round(MAE, 0),
                                        PRD = ifelse(is.na(PRD), "", round(PRD, 2))) %>%
                                 arrange(model_approach, municipality_type, dataset_type) %>%
                                 rename(Approach = model_approach,
                                        Type = dataset_type,
                                        `Municipality type` = municipality_type,
                                        `MAPE [%]` = MAPE,
                                        `MAE [DKK]` = MAE,
                                        `PM20 [%]` = PM20,
                                        `COD [%]` = COD)
       
saveRDS(performance_sorted_lot_models, "saved_files/performance_sorted_lot_models.rds")

# -------------------------

# -------------------------

kable(performance_sorted_lot_models,

      booktabs = TRUE) %>%
kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```

## 4.5 Prediction stability
The code below evaluates the stability of predicted lot values across the fold-specific models for each of the three modelling approaches. All models within an ensemble are used to predict lot values for the same set of properties on the link scale. For each property, the mean prediction and the standard deviation across the fold-specific predictions are calculated. The standard deviation across the model ensembles is used as a measure of sensitivity to perturbations of the training data.

```{r Stability lot models, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# -------------------------
# 1. Settings
# -------------------------

cap <- 0.2

model_sets <- list("Direct lot model" = models_direct,
                   "Standard property model" = models_standard_property,
                   "Combined model" = models_combined)

# -------------------------
# 2. Prepare prediction datasets
# -------------------------

dataset_properties_combined_lot <- dataset_properties_standardized %>% 
                                   mutate(type = factor("Lot sale", levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")),
                                          type_ordered = ordered("Lot sale", levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")))

prediction_datasets <- list("Direct lot model" = dataset_properties,
                            "Standard property model" = dataset_properties,
                            "Combined model" = dataset_properties_combined_lot)

# -------------------------
# 3. Ensemble spread function
# -------------------------

spread_model_set <- function(model_set, dataset) {
  
  predictions <- imap(model_set, function(model, fold_name) {
    
    preds <- predict.gam(model,
                         newdata = dataset,
                         type = "link")
    
    tibble(!!paste0("pred_", fold_name) := as.vector(preds))
    
  })
  
  pred_matrix <- bind_cols(predictions)
  pred_mat <- as.matrix(pred_matrix)
  
  bind_cols(dataset, pred_matrix) %>%
  mutate(mean_Ensemble = rowMeans(pred_mat, na.rm = TRUE),
         sigma_Ensemble = apply(pred_mat, 1, sd, na.rm = TRUE))
}

# -------------------------
# 4. Predict for all three approaches
# -------------------------

if (load) {
  
  dataset_spread <- readRDS("saved_files/dataset_spread.rds")
  
} else {
  
  dataset_spread <- imap(
    model_sets,
    function(model_set, model_approach) {
      
      message("Predicting ensemble spread for ", model_approach, " ...")
      
      spread_model_set(model_set = model_set, dataset = prediction_datasets[[model_approach]])
      
    }
  )
  
  saveRDS(dataset_spread, "saved_files/dataset_spread.rds")
}

# -------------------------
# 5. Long-format spread data
# -------------------------

spread_long <- imap_dfr(
  dataset_spread,
  function(df, model_approach) {
    
    df %>% transmute(model_approach = model_approach, sigma_Ensemble = sigma_Ensemble)
    
  }
)

saveRDS(spread_long, "saved_files/spread_long.rds")

# -------------------------
# 6. Summary table
# -------------------------

spread_summary <- spread_long %>%
                  group_by(model_approach) %>%
                  summarise(mean_sigma = mean(sigma_Ensemble, na.rm = TRUE),
                            median_sigma = median(sigma_Ensemble, na.rm = TRUE),
                            p75_sigma = quantile(sigma_Ensemble, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
                            p90_sigma = quantile(sigma_Ensemble, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
                            p95_sigma = quantile(sigma_Ensemble, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
                            .groups = "drop")

saveRDS(spread_summary, "saved_files/spread_summary.rds")

# -------------------------
# 7. Density plot: all models in one plot
# -------------------------

plot_ensemble_density <- ggplot(filter(spread_long, sigma_Ensemble < 1.0),
                                aes(x = sigma_Ensemble,
                                    color = model_approach,
                                    fill = model_approach)) +
                         geom_density(alpha = 0.15,
                                      linewidth = 0.8,
                                      na.rm = TRUE) +
                         coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, cap)) +
                         labs(title = "Ensemble spread across lot-value approaches",
                              x = "Ensemble spread (link scale)",
                              y = "Density",
                              color = NULL,
                              fill = NULL) +
                         theme_minimal() +
                         theme(legend.position = c(0.7, 0.75))

saveRDS(plot_ensemble_density, "saved_files/plot_ensemble_density.rds")
print(plot_ensemble_density)

# -------------------------
# 8. Base map
# -------------------------

base_map <- ggplot() +
            geom_contour(data = coordinate_grid,
                         aes(x = coordinate_east,
                             y = coordinate_north,
                             z = as.numeric(!ocean)),
                         color = "black",
                         linewidth = 0.1) +
            coord_fixed() +
            theme_void(base_size = 10)

# -------------------------
# 9. Geographic uncertainty plots
# -------------------------

plot_ensemble_geographic <- imap(
  dataset_spread,
  function(df, model_approach) {
    
    base_map +
    geom_point(data = df,
               aes(x = coordinate_east,
                   y = coordinate_north,
                   color = sigma_Ensemble),
               size = 0.2) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma",
                          name = "Ensemble uncertainty",
                          limits = c(0, cap),
                          oob = squish) +
    labs(title = paste(model_approach, "- Ensemble uncertainty")) +
    theme(legend.position = c(0.7, 0.75), 
          legend.box = "horizontal")
  }
)

saveRDS(plot_ensemble_geographic, "saved_files/plot_ensemble_geographic.rds")
wrap_plots(plot_ensemble_geographic, ncol = 2)

```

## 4.6 Property-lot-building decomposition
The code below decomposes predicted property values into estimated lot and building components for each modelling approach and cross-validation fold. For the direct and standard-property approaches, property values are taken from the previously fitted property models, while lot values are predicted using the corresponding lot model. For the combined approach, property, standardized-property, and lot values are generated from the same joint model by changing the sale type and building characteristics supplied at prediction.

Building value is defined as the difference between the predicted property value and predicted lot value. The same decomposition is also calculated for the standardized property. The resulting values are summarized using measures of central tendency, dispersion, selected quantiles, building shares, values per square metre, and the frequency of negative building-value estimates.

```{r Property, building and lot values, eval=FALSE, echo=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

# -------------------------
# Property, lot and building value decomposition
# -------------------------

# -------------------------
# Settings
# -------------------------

x_limits <- c(-2, 15)
density_adjust <- 1.5

building_value_limits <- c(-2, 8)
living_space_limits <- c(0, 400)
year_built_limits <- c(1900, 2024)

model_sets <- list(direct_lot_model = models_direct,
                   standard_property_model = models_standard_property,
                   combined_model = models_combined)

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------

prepare_type <- function(data, type_value) {
  
  data %>% mutate(type = factor(type_value, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")),
                  type_ordered = ordered(type, levels = c("Lot sale", "Property sale")))
}

get_property_value_vars <- function(fold_name) {
  
  property_model <- str_extract(fold_name, "Model\\d+")
  stopifnot(!is.na(property_model))
  
  list(property_value_var = paste0("property_value_", property_model),
       standard_property_value_var = paste0("standard_property_value_", property_model))
  
}

decompose_models <- function(model_set,
                             dataset_properties,
                             dataset_properties_standardized,
                             combined = FALSE) {
  
  imap(model_set, function(model, fold_name) {
    
    if (combined) {
      
      lot_value <- predict.gam(model,
                               newdata = prepare_type(dataset_properties_standardized, "Lot sale"),
                               type = "response") %>% 
                   as.vector()
      
      property_value <- predict.gam(model,
                                    newdata = prepare_type(dataset_properties, "Property sale"),
                                    type = "response") %>% 
                        as.vector()
      
      standard_property_value <- predict.gam(model,
                                             newdata = prepare_type(dataset_properties_standardized, "Property sale"),
                                             type = "response") %>% 
                                 as.vector()
      
    } else {
      
      vars <- get_property_value_vars(fold_name)
      
      lot_value <- predict.gam(model,
                               newdata = dataset_properties,
                               type = "response") %>% 
                   as.vector()
      
      property_value <- dataset_properties[[vars$property_value_var]]
      standard_property_value <- dataset_properties[[vars$standard_property_value_var]]
      
    }
    
    building_value <- property_value - lot_value
    standard_building_value <- standard_property_value - lot_value
    
    tibble(id = dataset_properties$id,
           property_value = property_value,
           standard_property_value = standard_property_value,
           lot_value = lot_value,
           building_value = building_value,
           standard_building_value = standard_building_value,
           building_share = building_value / property_value,
           standard_building_share = standard_building_value / standard_property_value,
           building_value_per_m2 = building_value / dataset_properties$living_space,
           standard_building_value_per_m2 = standard_building_value / 140,
           living_space = dataset_properties$living_space,
           year_built = dataset_properties$year_built)
    
  })
}


summarise_value <- function(x, prefix) {
  
  tibble(!!paste0(prefix, "_mean") := mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_median") := median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_sd") := sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_mad") := mad(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_iqr") := IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q05") := quantile(x, 0.05, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q10") := quantile(x, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q25") := quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q75") := quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q90") := quantile(x, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_q95") := quantile(x, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_min") := min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_max") := max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_n_negative") := sum(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
         !!paste0(prefix, "_share_negative") := mean(x < 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100)
}

summarise_decomposition <- function(df) {
  
  bind_cols(tibble(n = nrow(df)),
            summarise_value(df$property_value, "property_value"),
            summarise_value(df$standard_property_value, "standard_property_value"),
            summarise_value(df$lot_value, "lot_value"),
            summarise_value(df$building_value, "building_value"),
            summarise_value(df$standard_building_value, "standard_building_value"),
            summarise_value(df$building_share, "building_share"),
            summarise_value(df$standard_building_share, "standard_building_share"),
            summarise_value(df$building_value_per_m2, "building_value_per_m2"),
            summarise_value(df$standard_building_value_per_m2, "standard_building_value_per_m2"))
}

density_layer <- function(df, var, label) {
  
  df_layer <- df %>%
              transmute(value = .data[[var]] / 1e6) %>%
              filter(is.finite(value),
                     value >= x_limits[1],
                     value <= x_limits[2])
  
  geom_density(data = df_layer,
               mapping = aes(x = value, color = label, fill = label),
               alpha = 0.3,
               linewidth = 0.8,
               adjust = density_adjust,
               na.rm = TRUE)
}

make_density_plot <- function(df, model_approach, fold_name) {
  
  ggplot() + density_layer(df, "property_value", "Property value") +
             density_layer(df, "standard_property_value", "Standard property value") +
             density_layer(df, "lot_value", "Lot value") +
             density_layer(df, "building_value", "Building value") +
             density_layer(df, "standard_building_value", "Standard building value") +
             coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits) +
             scale_x_continuous(labels = label_number(suffix = "M")) +
             scale_color_discrete(name = NULL) +
             scale_fill_discrete(name = NULL) +
             labs(title = paste(model_approach, "-", fold_name),
                  x = "Value [million DKK]",
                  y = "Density") +
             theme_minimal()
}

# -------------------------
# Decomposition
# -------------------------

if (load) {
  
  property_decomposition <- readRDS("saved_files/property_decomposition.rds")
  
} else {
  
  property_decomposition <- list(
    direct_lot_model = decompose_models(
      model_set = model_sets$direct_lot_model,
      dataset_properties = dataset_properties,
      dataset_properties_standardized = dataset_properties_standardized,
      combined = FALSE
    ),
    standard_property_model = decompose_models(
      model_set = model_sets$standard_property_model,
      dataset_properties = dataset_properties,
      dataset_properties_standardized = dataset_properties_standardized,
      combined = FALSE
    ),
    combined_model = decompose_models(
      model_set = model_sets$combined_model,
      dataset_properties = dataset_properties,
      dataset_properties_standardized = dataset_properties_standardized,
      combined = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  saveRDS(property_decomposition, "saved_files/property_decomposition.rds")
}

# -------------------------
# Decomposition summary
# -------------------------

decomposition_summary <- imap_dfr(
  property_decomposition,
  function(model_set, model_approach) {
    
    imap_dfr(model_set, function(df, fold_name) {
      
      summarise_decomposition(df) %>%
        mutate(
          model_approach = model_approach,
          fold_name = fold_name,
          .before = 1
        )
    })
  }
)

saveRDS(decomposition_summary, "saved_files/decomposition_summary.rds")

# -------------------------
# Compact building-value summary
# -------------------------

make_building_diagnostic_plot <- function(x_var, x_label, x_limits_plot) {

             filter(is.finite(.data[[x_var]]),

                    .data[[x_var]] >= x_limits_plot[1],
                    .data[[x_var]] <= x_limits_plot[2],
                    building_value_million >= building_value_limits[1],
                    building_value_million <= building_value_limits[2])
  
  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = .data[[x_var]],

              x = x_label,
              y = "Building value [million DKK]",
              color = NULL,
              linetype = "Fold") +
         theme_minimal()
}
```
